'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Terrorism in Iran]]
**Five people are killed and 15 others are injured in a [[mass shooting]] at a market in [[Izeh]], [[Khuzestan province]], [[Iran]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/least-four-killed-terrorist-attack-irans-khuzestan-province-state-media-2022-11-16/ (Reuters)]
*[[Mali War]]
**[[Germany]] announces the withdrawal of its ''[[Bundeswehr]]'' personnel in the [[United Nations Multidimensional Integrated Stabilization Mission in Mali]] until the end of 2023. [https://english.almayadeen.net/news/politics/germany-to-withdraw-troops-from-mali-by-the-end-of-2023 (AFP via Al Mayadeen)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2021–2022 inflation surge]]
**[[2021–present United Kingdom cost of living crisis]]
***[[Inflation]] in the [[United Kingdom]] reaches a record 11.1%, pressuring the [[Bank of England]] to raise [[interest rates]]. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2022-11-16/uk-inflation-jumps-more-than-expected-to-41-year-high-of-11-1?leadSource=uverify%20wall (Bloomberg)]
*[[Economic impact of the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**The [[economy of Russia]] enters a [[recession]], after [[gross domestic product]] decreased by four percent in the third quarter. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2022/11/16/Russia-falls-into-recession- (AFP via Al Arabiya)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
* Four people are killed in a fire in a hotel in [[Chrząstowice]] near [[Opole]], [[Poland]]. [https://www.ratownictwo.opole.pl/2022/11/plonie-kompleks-hotelowy-w-chrzastowicach-sa-osoby-poszkodowane-niestety-jedna-osoba-nie-zyje/ (O!Polskie Ratownictwo)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Tigray War]]
**Aftermath of the [[Ethiopia–Tigray peace agreement]]
***The [[World Food Programme]] resumes its deployment of [[humanitarian aid]] to the [[Tigray Region]] for the first time since the signing of the [[Ethiopia–Tigray peace agreement|peace agreement]]. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/international-news/20221116-wfp-says-its-first-aid-convoy-since-ethiopia-peace-deal-enters-tigray (AFP via RFI)]
*[[Greece–Iran relations]]
**The two [[Greece|Greek]] [[Tanker (ship)|tankers]] that [[Iran]] impounded in May to [[Reciprocity (international relations)|reciprocate]] Greece's seizure of an Iranian tanker are discharged. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/iran-releases-greek-oil-tankers-it-seized-in-may-says-athens/ (AFP via ''The Times of Israel'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Capital punishment in Kuwait]]
**[[Kuwait]] says that it has carried out a [[mass execution]] of seven [[conviction|convicted]] [[murder]]ers, including three foreign citizens. [https://www.yahoo.com/news/kuwait-puts-death-7-death-101515925.html (Yahoo! News)]
*Twenty-five recruits of the [[Los Angeles County Sheriff's Department]] are injured, five of them critically, in a collision with a wrong-way driver in [[Whittier, California]], [[United States]].
